source: Pravana ChromaSilk Vivids technical data sheet

numbering_system.description: Pravana ChromaSilk Vivids use descriptive names. No developer needed. Semi-permanent direct dye.

additives.Clear: Lighten or pastelize any Vivids shade
additives.Black: Deepen or darken any Vivids shade

lines.name: ChromaSilk Vivids
lines.description: Semi-permanent direct dyes lasting 3-12 weeks. Must pre-lighten hair before application. Mix with Vivids Clear to lighten/pastelize.
lines.notes: Available in standard, Neon, Pastel, and Locked-In series.

developers.note: Vivids do not require developer. They are direct dyes applied to pre-lightened hair.

formulation_guidelines.preparation: Hair must be pre-lightened to the appropriate level before applying Vivids.
formulation_guidelines.application: Apply to clean, dry, pre-lightened hair. Process 20-30 minutes at room temperature.

mixing.custom_shades: Mix Vivids shades together to create custom colors
mixing.pastelize: Mix with Vivids Clear to lighten/pastelize
mixing.deepen: Mix with Vivids Black to deepen/darken

processing_times.vibrant_result: Up to 30 minutes for maximum vibrancy

formulation_guidelines.longevity: Lasts 3-12 weeks depending on shade, hair porosity, and aftercare routine.
